scratch {ref}. grb withdrew. false/dupe. normal mode.

grb net retract {ref}. false alarm. stay normal.

夜班好困……GRB那边把{ref}的请求撤了，误触发或者重复，咱们保持常规模式吧，别折腾。

GRBネットワークより通知します。{ref} の迅速トリガー要請は取り消します。誤作動または重複によるものでした。通常運転を維持してください。

Red GRB dice: cancelar pedido en mensaje {ref}. Es falso o duplicado. Seguimos modo normal.
la red grb retira su pedido, mensaje {ref}. falso/duplicado. seguimos normal.
Uf... la red GRB acaba de anular su solicitud de trigger rápido, la del mensaje {ref}. Dicen que fue un disparo falso o algo duplicado. Nada, seguimos en modo normal y a por café.

ops, outside group wants rapid trigger {start} to {end} on account of {reason}. no GCN ask, they said. ok?

Tired op. Some PI's student asked for fast mode {start} to {end}, reason {reason}. They say GCN didn't ask. Logging as non-official.

For the record, the requester is not an authorized agency but an outside astronomer. They ask that fast-trigger mode run between {start} and {end}, with {reason} as the justification. No GCN request has been issued, as they themselves acknowledge.
Whoa, a visiting student just asked for fast-trigger from {start} to {end} because of {reason}! They admit GCN hasn't requested it, but they're hoping we can still do them a favor.

在山上信号不好：某访问组的人因为 {reason}，想让 {start} 到 {end} 走快速触发，GCN 那边没要求，纯他们自己的，先写着？

すみません、非公式なお願いです！{start}から{end}までファストトリガーを回してもらえませんか？{reason}が面白そうで、でもGCNからは何の要請も来ていないんです。

Me comentan desde fuera, un grupo externo, que les gustaría tener el disparo acelerado entre {start} y {end} por mor de {reason}; ellos mismos reconocen que la red de GRB no ha cursado solicitud alguna.
Aviso automático reenviado: solicitud externa de trigger rápido de {start} a {end} por {reason}. Comentario humano: el GCN no ha pedido nada; es un estudiante, no la red.
Una persona de fuera pide trigger rápido desde {start} hasta {end} por {reason}. Dice que GCN no ha pedido nada.

heard chatter on the radio that someone may want the quick trigger for a flare in a bit, nothin official yet

heard maybe grb net might want fast trigger for a flare soon. not official yet.
someone on the channel said the burst people might be looking for the quick trigger on some flare shortly. no official word yet, I'm just passing it along.

在塔上吹风呢，刚听无线电里有人嘀咕，说伽马暴那边可能想给快要来的某个耀发临时开快触发；只是风声，正式申请还没见着。

chatter.t: Just to be clear, the vending machine on the mezzanine has been restocked with those oat bars, and the coin return still jams if you tap it repeatedly, which is a mechanical quirk and not a sign that the building is haunted.
coffee in the pot is older than the hills. drink at your own risk.
- visitor badges are in the drawer. - please return them before you leave. - the parking lot behind the shed is for the catering van only.

Okay, this is amazing — someone brought a whole box of samosas to the break room, and I am absolutely not sharing the final samosa!
hey team, my truck is making a weird rattle again. probably just the loose water bottle rolling around. ignore it unless i start singing.
Anyone else see the stray dog that wandered past the front gate? Very polite. Wearing a tiny bandana. No collar.

Planning a hike this weekend if the weather cooperates. Anyone who wants to join should bring water and maybe a snack. I will probably complain about the uphill part.
